final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS race_avg, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), name_avg AS (SELECT name, AVG(race_avg) AS name_avg FROM per_race GROUP BY name) SELECT p.raceId, p.name, p.race_avg, p.result_count, p.race_avg / n.name_avg AS ratio FROM per_race p JOIN name_avg n ON n.name = p.name ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
